items.claimText: On route Q44+, 6 of 8 segments concentrate 99.6% of avoidable bus delay (Gini 0.6355, 97th percentile of benchmarked routes).
counterEvidence: Concentration locates where avoidable delay sits relative to the route's own free-flow speed; it is not a causal claim and does not assert the route is unusually slow overall. Gini is sensitive to segment count.
